columns.comment: ER run id ER-yyyymmdd (the as-of date of the source snapshot it resolved).
columns.name: run_id

columns.comment: As-of date of the source-record snapshot the run resolved (the grain date).
columns.name: run_date

columns.comment: Rule set: v1 (2025 runs) or v2 (from the Mar-2026 run: abbreviation expansion, name + country exact match, cross-country blocking).
columns.name: rule_version

columns.comment: Short description of the rule set used by the run.
columns.name: rule_set_note

columns.comment: Run sequence 1-6 in date order.
columns.name: run_seq

columns.comment: True for the latest run (ER-20260930) - the current resolution.
columns.name: is_latest_run

columns.comment: True for the first run of a new rule set (ER-20260331 = first v2 run).
columns.name: is_rule_version_change

columns.comment: Identity source system (core_customer, crm_account, kyc_customer, credit_obligor, trade_party, tsy_counterparty, ext_company_master) or ALL for the whole run.
columns.name: source_system

columns.comment: True for the ALL row (run totals across all source systems).
columns.name: is_all_sources

columns.comment: Source identity records in the run snapshot (for ALL = all systems).
columns.name: records_in

columns.comment: Records that were new since the previous run (all records for the first run).
columns.name: records_new

columns.comment: Records linked by a deterministic rule (LEI-like id, tax id + country, v2: name + legal form + country).
columns.name: matched_deterministic

columns.comment: Records linked by an automatic fuzzy match (score >= 0.90).
columns.name: matched_fuzzy

columns.comment: Records linked through a data-steward decision (score 0.75-0.90; simulated review).
columns.name: steward_resolved

columns.comment: Records matched to at least one other record = deterministic + fuzzy + steward.
columns.name: matched_total

columns.comment: Records left as singleton golden records (no link accepted).
columns.name: unmatched

columns.comment: Match rate = matched_total / records_in (fraction; 0.987 = 98.7%). For other grains recompute as SUM(matched_total) / SUM(records_in).
columns.name: match_rate

columns.comment: Share of matched records linked by fuzzy matching = matched_fuzzy / matched_total (fraction).
columns.name: fuzzy_share

columns.comment: Share of matched records linked by a steward decision = steward_resolved / matched_total (fraction).
columns.name: steward_share

columns.comment: Within-source duplicates merged = records beyond the first of the same source system in a golden record.
columns.name: duplicates_merged

columns.comment: Golden records holding at least one record of the source (ALL = golden records issued by the run; 9,270 records collapse into 2,550 golden records at the latest run).
columns.name: golden_records

columns.comment: Records minus golden records - how many source records collapsed through resolution.
columns.name: records_collapsed

columns.comment: Average source records per golden record.
columns.name: records_per_golden

columns.comment: Golden ids newly issued in the run (ALL row only; null on source rows).
columns.name: golden_new

columns.comment: Golden records merged into an older golden id in the run (ALL row only).
columns.name: golden_merged

columns.comment: Golden records split in the run (ALL row only; 0 in every run so far).
columns.name: golden_split

columns.comment: Candidate record pairs produced by blocking and scored.
columns.name: candidate_pairs

columns.comment: Candidate pairs linked deterministically.
columns.name: deterministic_pairs

columns.comment: Candidate pairs auto-matched by the fuzzy score (>= 0.90).
columns.name: auto_match_pairs

columns.comment: Candidate pairs in the steward band (0.75-0.90).
columns.name: steward_band_pairs

columns.comment: Steward queue items raised by the run (see fact_steward_queue).
columns.name: steward_items

columns.comment: Steward items of the run still open at the as-of date.
columns.name: steward_items_open

columns.comment: Record links accepted (deterministic + fuzzy + steward match).
columns.name: links_accepted

columns.comment: Same-entity record pairs according to the synthetic truth (evaluation only).
columns.name: true_pairs

columns.comment: Record pairs the run put in the same golden record.
columns.name: predicted_pairs

columns.comment: Predicted pairs that are true pairs (true positives).
columns.name: tp_pairs

columns.comment: Pairwise precision = tp_pairs / predicted_pairs vs the synthetic truth (fraction; gate >= 0.97 at the latest run). Recompute SUM(tp_pairs) / SUM(predicted_pairs) within one source system or the ALL row.
columns.name: precision

columns.comment: Pairwise recall = tp_pairs / true_pairs vs the synthetic truth (fraction; gate >= 0.95; v1 runs lower - that is the story).
columns.name: recall

columns.comment: Cluster purity vs the synthetic truth (ALL row only; fraction).
columns.name: purity

columns.comment: Change of precision vs the previous run of the same source system (fraction points).
columns.name: precision_change_vs_prev_run

columns.comment: Change of recall vs the previous run of the same source system (fraction points; jumps at the first v2 run).
columns.name: recall_change_vs_prev_run

columns.comment: Simulated start of the run (UTC).
columns.name: started_at

columns.comment: Simulated end of the run (UTC).
columns.name: finished_at

columns.comment: Run duration in minutes.
columns.name: duration_minutes

comment: Entity-resolution run quality: the six quarterly ER runs (30-Jun-2025, 30-Sep-2025 and 31-Dec-2025 with rule set v1; 31-Mar-2026, 30-Jun-2026 and 30-Sep-2026 with v2) per identity source system, plus one ALL row per run for the run as a whole. Records in, matched deterministically / fuzzily / by a data steward, unmatched, within-source duplicates merged, golden records, candidate pairs, steward items and the pairwise precision / recall and cluster purity the ER job measured against the synthetic truth. Counts of the ALL row are the run totals; per-source rows count pairs involving that source, so pair counts and golden records of the source rows do not add up to ALL - use the ALL row for run totals. Grain: one row per ER run per source system (plus source_system ALL for the whole run).
